labels.symptom: There is no Dockerfile for hosting the app.
Panels cannot be docked above the properties area, and the Help menu is missing Report an Issue and Check for Updates.
Clicking one of several selected anchors does not deselect the others.
labels.root_cause: Selection is not narrowed to the clicked anchor on mouse-up when there was no drag.

labels.symptom: Shape corner points cannot be switched between sharp and curved.
There is no in-app guide for finding the command-line tool and setting up an agent's MCP connection.
Desktop installs have no documented, reliable way to run the command-line tool, and on macOS it is a separate download.
labels.root_cause: Packaging puts the CLI in different places on each platform or leaves it out, and its invocation is not documented.

labels.symptom: There is no infinite canvas document type with unlimited zoom and panning.
After updating, zooming and panning the canvas is extremely slow.
Pressing the down arrow key in the font picker does not change the selected font.
Where overlapping shapes share colinear edges, slivers of the lower shape show through in exports and sometimes on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: Anti-aliasing at shared edges lets the coverage of the lower shape bleed through.

labels.symptom: An Illustrator EPS that used to import correctly now opens with a shorter page, missing text strokes and overlapping multi-line text.
labels.root_cause: A regression in the EPS import path changed page-size handling and how text objects are converted.

labels.symptom: There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
The Blend tool has no on-canvas controls and only limited easing options.
The source paths of a blend can't have anchor points added or be extended without recreating the blend.
Arrowheads point in the wrong direction with the default extend-past-path align mode.
The Scripts menu does nothing, so JavaScript scripts cannot be run.
Web users can't add their own fonts from a link or a file; only fonts bundled at build time are available.
labels.root_cause: The web font set is fixed at compile time from a font list file.

labels.symptom: After an update, opening even small files freezes or crashes the app, though the previous version opened them fine.
Moving, dragging or undoing a large selection gets much slower as the selection grows, and live effects are recalculated every frame.
labels.root_cause: Every lookup by id walks the whole document tree, so editing a selection takes quadratic time.

labels.symptom: On macOS, fonts activated by font managers such as TypeFace or RightFont don't appear in the font list.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery likely only scans the standard font directories and misses fonts activated at runtime by font managers.

labels.symptom: Changing the distribute-spacing value doesn't update the selected objects live; you have to re-apply it.
Right-to-left languages like Arabic show in the interface as disconnected letters in the wrong order.
labels.root_cause: egui lays out text with no bidi reordering and no OpenType shaping.

labels.symptom: New or unsaved documents are not autosaved, and the documents that were open are not reopened after a restart.
labels.root_cause: There is no periodic autosave to a temp folder and no record of open documents.

labels.symptom: The plug-ins folder preference exists, but no plug-ins are loaded from it.
labels.root_cause: There is no plug-in host yet.

labels.symptom: Scripts written for Illustrator (.jsx, AppleScript, VBScript) fail because its object model isn't there.
labels.root_cause: Only the app's own command API is exposed to scripts, not Illustrator's object model.

labels.symptom: The ruler origin (zero point) can't be moved or reset.
Clicking an object with the artboard tool does not create an artboard.
Dragging one corner radius handle rounds all four corners at once.
The original object bounds stay visible while dragging corner radius handles.
Adwaita and Breeze themes are not available.
Modifier-click doesn't select a subset of corner radius widgets, so all corners change together.
The eyedropper can't sample the artboard background colour.
The curvature tool shows full anchor handles, and dragging a point doesn't smoothly adjust the neighbouring curve segments.
PDF export ignores the CMYK colour setting and always writes sRGB.
Large documents use far more memory than they need, and memory keeps growing during a session.
labels.root_cause: Undo history is capped by step count rather than size, and decoded images and render caches are never evicted.

labels.symptom: Mouse clicks do nothing unless the window is full screen.
Importing .AI files turns strokes into objects and drops hidden layers, and Wacom Art Pen brushes aren't supported.
Many settings in the Preferences dialog are saved but have no effect.
labels.root_cause: Preference fields are stored, but no code reads them.

labels.symptom: On mobile web the UI is unusable because it does not adapt to small or portrait screens or to touch input.
labels.root_cause: The layout and input handling assume a desktop-sized screen.

labels.symptom: Guides and shapes don't snap to shape midpoints or artboard edges, and guides can't be limited to one artboard or locked from the Layers panel.
An EPS vector text-effect file fails to open or shows an error.
The apps are not published on Flathub, so Linux users get no easy install or automatic updates.
The app menu has redundant items that are also available elsewhere.
On the Linux AppImage the mouse pointer moves in slow motion over the window, so the app looks frozen.
On macOS the app can't be installed or updated with Homebrew cask.
A contributor offers to implement 3D and Materials features, starting with Revolve.
There is no 'check for updates' option.
On Windows, launching the exe shows nothing: no window, no error and no lingering process.
Japanese line breaking uses a single strict kinsoku set and offers no choice of JLREQ level.
labels.root_cause: A single fixed no_line_start/no_line_end set is stricter than JLREQ's default level.

labels.symptom: Vectors outside the artboard in .ai files are not shown.
Fixes and features must be ported by hand between apps whose copied code has drifted.
labels.root_cause: The apps were copied from one template and share no common crates.

labels.symptom: Presets don't open on double-click, the welcome screen has no recent documents, the Discord button is too prominent, and document files have no Finder thumbnail or Quick Look preview.
Documents cannot be saved in Affinity .af format.
labels.root_cause: No Affinity container or object-stream writer exists, and there is no way to validate output in Affinity.

labels.symptom: Opening Affinity documents drops or simplifies effects, adjustments, brushes, master pages, special shapes and other features.
labels.root_cause: The native Affinity importer does not yet map these record types.

labels.symptom: Third-party plug-ins such as cutting-plotter drivers cannot be used.
Text in imported PDF figures, such as axis labels, shows up shifted from where it should be.
labels.root_cause: Text positioning is likely wrong during PDF import.

labels.symptom: Mouse movement on the canvas feels smoothed or laggy, which hurts precision.
Opening some .ai files with embedded images became about 4x slower.
labels.root_cause: Each layer comparison creates a new Renderer, redrawing the page and redecoding every image.

labels.symptom: A Wacom pen display does nothing on Linux.
User asks for generative fill that creates artwork constrained to a shape.
Guides and non-printing construction lines are lost when importing .ai files, and files saved without PDF compatibility open as an empty artboard.
labels.root_cause: The .ai importer reads only the PDF-compatible part and ignores guides and the native private data.

labels.symptom: In a multi-step CLI run, a later step can't use an earlier step's result id, and some commands silently act on the current selection instead.
labels.root_cause: The run command doesn't resolve $N.id step references in every command's parameters.

labels.symptom: Artboards cannot be deleted or resized, and keyboard shortcuts only work with an English keyboard layout.
labels.root_cause: Shortcuts may be matched on the logical key rather than the physical key.

labels.symptom: Tools are missing compared with CorelDRAW, CorelDRAW files can't be opened, and drawing and page layout need two separate apps.
On some Windows 11 versions, including 26H1 and LTSC builds, launching the app does nothing and no process starts.
The app has no System theme option, so it does not follow the macOS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: Theme comes only from the saved manual setting; nothing reads the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: Tool panels are fixed in place and can't be moved, closed or rearranged.
While dragging to draw a curve, the preview stays frozen and only updates after the mouse is released.
Imported Illustrator text blocks split into separate lines, and text outlines can't be edited in the Color panel.
Scripts can't be run (Ctrl+F12 does nothing) and the 3D effect doesn't work.
There are no brush options or pen pressure settings for a drawing tablet.
Exported SVGs come out at 75% of their real size, and unit preferences go back to points after a restart.
labels.root_cause: Probably a pt/px conversion error on SVG export, and the units preference is not saved.

labels.symptom: The macOS save dialog has no file-type selector, unlike the Windows one.
labels.root_cause: The native macOS save panel is shown without a file format accessory.

labels.symptom: Layers and groups are flattened when .ai files are exported to or imported from Illustrator.
labels.root_cause: The .ai import and export do not preserve the layer and group structure.

labels.symptom: General request to add more features from the reference app.
Checkboxes in dialogs stay invisible until you hover over them, and several dialog options are missing.
labels.root_cause: The theme draws idle checkbox frames with no visible stroke or fill.

labels.symptom: You can't change what the rightmost docked panel contains, reorder its side bar, or dock panels on the left edge.
On Windows 7 the 32-bit build shows an error and does not open.
A single live corner widget cannot be clicked and dragged to round one corner unless its anchor is selected first.
Snapping to nodes is missing, and marquee selection with the Direct Selection tool can't include text objects.
Importing an Illustrator file creates many disorganized layers instead of keeping the original layer structure.
On macOS, text copied from other apps does not paste.
A user suggests basing the UI design on Affinity.
On Windows laptops with two GPUs the app shows no window but keeps running as a background process.
Shift-rotating a shape always snaps in fixed 45° steps with no way to change the step.
labels.root_cause: The rotation snap increment is hard-coded to 45°.

labels.symptom: Sign-making and cutting tools like nesting, contour cutting and G-code export are missing.
The Color panel only offers RGB sliders, with no color boxes or wheel picker.
You can't place another project file into a document as an editable linked or embedded object.
Fill color on some imported vectors can't be edited, and the color info shown depends on which selection tool is active.
Variable-width stroke preview gets wider as you zoom in, though the final render is correct.
Closing or quitting does not ask whether to save unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: There was no unsaved-changes prompt on close or quit.

labels.symptom: Wrapped and aligned area text exported to SVG shows as single lines running out of the frame.
labels.root_cause: The exporter wrote one tspan per paragraph at the frame's top-left instead of one per laid-out line.

labels.symptom: Export for Screens can download files on the web, zip its output, and its default folder was wrong on Windows.
SVG export gains encoding choices, the SVG Tiny 1.2 profile and embedded font subsets, and SVG files in UTF-16 or Latin-1 open again.
Integer values changed in a command dialog are ignored and the defaults are used.
labels.root_cause: The generic parameter dialog turned edited integers into floating-point JSON numbers.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift or Ctrl while clicking the numeric stepper buttons does not change the step size.
labels.root_cause: The shared numeric spinner's click handler ignored modifier keys.

labels.symptom: The Brush Strokes raster effects are missing.
Version bump to 0.2.0.
Floating panels can't be stacked into sets or docked as extra columns.
Ruler guides don't belong to layers and aren't listed in the Layers panel.
Shift-clicking cannot select ruler guides and artwork together.
A PDF font that is not embedded imports with the wrong style, such as Helvetica coming in as a Medium face.
labels.root_cause: Glyph comparison against a stand-in font chose the closest installed style instead of keeping the style the font name gives.

labels.symptom: Documents can be exported as EPS files with previews.
The tool and panel icon columns cannot be widened to show names next to the icons.
A linked file placed while the app is idle can miss its first change, so the placed image stays out of date.
labels.root_cause: The link watch stopped waking up because its 'found links' flag was only refreshed when a check was due.

labels.symptom: Applying Offset Path with miter joins to some outlines freezes the app while memory grows until it runs out.
labels.root_cause: An infinite loop in the linesweeper 0.4 sweep-line used for path boolean/offset arrangement.

labels.symptom: Clicking the fill of an open filled path misses on the side of its implicit closing edge, and rotate cursor and flip icons point the wrong way.
labels.root_cause: Fill hit-testing counted winding without the implicit closing edge of open subpaths; flip icons were mapped by mirror-line name.

labels.symptom: Exported images show thin ghost lines where shapes meet edge to edge.
labels.root_cause: Each shape was anti-aliased on its own, so pixels on shared edges were only partly covered.

labels.symptom: Named text styles reject leading, kerning and mojikumi as unknown attributes.
labels.root_cause: Attribute keys were checked against the base style's serialized JSON, which leaves out fields at their default values.

labels.symptom: New art is placed on a hidden or locked layer when no editable layer exists.
labels.root_cause: When every layer was hidden or locked, the insertion layer fell back to the top layer anyway.
fixed_markers: the target layer is locked or hidden

labels.symptom: Replaying a batch of commands gives different results, and a batch that opens a new document is not recorded.
labels.root_cause: Batch steps dropped their recorded replay values, and batches that switched documents were not written to the journal.

labels.symptom: Text created on or inside a path through automation ignores the requested colour.
labels.root_cause: text.createInPath built its own character style without a colour, and add_text sent the colour only to text.create.

labels.symptom: An automation screenshot of the running app always captures the first page or artboard, whichever one is requested.
labels.root_cause: The desktop control server's ui.render ignored the artboard parameter.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool reports a broken pipe and exits with an error when the program reading its output closes early.
labels.root_cause: The CLI's step printer treated a closed stdout pipe as an error instead of the end of output.

labels.symptom: Select All on Active Artboard selects artwork on the first artboard instead of the active one.
labels.root_cause: The menu command sent no artboard index, so the engine fell back to the first artboard.

labels.symptom: Reversing a gradient moves an off-centre midpoint instead of mirroring it.
labels.root_cause: The midpoints were read after the stops had already been reordered.

labels.symptom: After scaling a text object, the Character panel shows the old font size and new sizes come out multiplied by the scale.
labels.root_cause: Character controls used local text units and ignored the object's affine transform.

labels.symptom: A polar grid set to zero radial dividers still draws one spoke.
labels.root_cause: The divider count was clamped with radial.max(1).

labels.symptom: With precise cursors turned on, the Pen still shows its join badge over another path's endpoint.
labels.root_cause: Cursor::precise did not include the PenJoin state.

labels.symptom: SVGs with one absolute and one unitless root dimension import stretched.
labels.root_cause: Each axis used a different unit scale when the root sizes mixed units.

labels.symptom: DXF drawings in US survey inches, yards or miles open at the wrong size as unitless.
labels.root_cause: INSUNITS codes 22–24 had no scale or name defined.

labels.symptom: Printing cannot lay the document out on paper as a print-ready PDF.
Every build recompiles most of the workspace on filesystems such as ecryptfs.
labels.root_cause: Build scripts rewrote generated files on every run even when unchanged, and coarse timestamps made those files look newer than the compile.

labels.symptom: An existing gradient mesh point can't be given a new colour.
labels.root_cause: Setting the fill did not know which mesh point was last clicked.

labels.symptom: The All Tools drawer stretches across most of a wide window.
labels.root_cause: The dialog had a minimum width but no maximum width.

labels.symptom: Text Wrap commands with some invalid object IDs change only some of the objects.
labels.root_cause: The shared target parser dropped invalid IDs with filter_map, and a wrongly typed ids parameter fell back to the selection.

labels.symptom: Freeform gradient lines with invalid point indices are silently shortened.
labels.root_cause: The parser used filter_map and treated malformed line structures as empty lists.

labels.symptom: The Live Corners dialog opens on unintended geometry when given invalid targets.
labels.root_cause: Object IDs and corner indices were parsed with lenient conversions and filter_map, so invalid values were treated as missing or dropped.

labels.symptom: Creating a saved view with bad coordinates or rotation quietly accepts wrong values.
labels.root_cause: The center parser did not check the array length, and an invalid rotation fell back to the default.

labels.symptom: The fuzz command sweep tests skipped cases for bugs that were already fixed.
labels.root_cause: A stale KNOWN_BUGS skip list was left in the test.

labels.symptom: Exported PDFs cannot be protected with open or permissions passwords.
bug_markers: password protection is not supported yet

labels.symptom: Align, Move or Arrange commands that change nothing still add an undo step and mark the document modified.
labels.root_cause: The commands edited the document even when the result was unchanged.

labels.symptom: Importing an EPS file with huge arc angles hangs forever.
labels.root_cause: The arc angle was normalised by adding 2π in a loop, which never ends for huge values.

labels.symptom: A development build looks the same as an installed release, so it is easy to test or report against the wrong one.
Proportional Metrics cannot be applied to full-width East Asian glyphs.
Importing an .ai file with global colours or pattern fills loses every sublayer.
labels.root_cause: The editing-data reader stopped on the Xk/XK and p/P operators and fell back to the PDF part.

labels.symptom: After a crash, unsaved changes to open documents are lost because there are no recovery copies.
labels.root_cause: No periodic recovery copies were written for modified documents.

labels.symptom: Legacy PostScript-form .ai files from CAD apps fail to open.
labels.root_cause: The PostScript interpreter stopped on Illustrator procset operators whose prolog was missing from the file.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
There is no single button that centres objects both horizontally and vertically.
Aligning to a key object inside a group or compound path moves the key object too.
labels.root_cause: The key object was only found when its own ID was among the objects being moved, not when it was inside a moved group.

labels.symptom: Choosing a colour with only some characters selected recolours the whole text object.
labels.root_cause: Fill and stroke commands applied paint to the whole object and ignored the selected character range.

labels.symptom: Spot colours defined in Lab open with wrong colours.
labels.root_cause: 3-component ICC profiles were always read as RGB, and the Lab values (type 2) in the editing data were ignored.

labels.symptom: The Layer Options dialog targets the wrong layers when given invalid layer IDs.
labels.root_cause: Malformed layer IDs were silently filtered, falling back to other layers.

labels.symptom: Shaper commands with invalid target IDs act on a different selection instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: Malformed explicit target IDs were filtered out instead of rejected.

labels.symptom: A request to remove width points with invalid indices deletes some of them instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: Invalid removal indices were silently dropped instead of rejected.

labels.symptom: DXF drawings cannot be opened or placed.
Unchecked checkboxes in the Preferences dialog have no visible outline in some themes.
labels.root_cause: The Preferences dialog drew its own checkboxes instead of the shared checkbox component, so the outline disappeared in some themes.

labels.symptom: Merging regions with Shape Builder on a grid of lines leaves seams that need a second pass to remove.
labels.root_cause: Planar faces had slightly different vertex coordinates, so the boolean union did not remove shared edges.

labels.symptom: With Proportional Metrics on, vertical type does not use the font's proportional heights.
Dropping a library, presets file or plug-in onto an open document fails with a 'not a format it reads' place error.
labels.root_cause: Drops with a document open always went through File › Place instead of the open path for these file kinds.

labels.symptom: Importing an .ai file with several artboards puts them all in one row and loses their grid layout.
labels.root_cause: The PDF-part fallback laid pages out in a row and ignored the ArtboardArray in the editing data.

labels.symptom: After Shift-clicking away the other object, the remaining object stays the key object and Align does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Selection pruning did not clear the key object when no other selected object remained.

labels.symptom: EMF and WMF files cannot be exported, opened, placed or pasted.
Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
Large whole-number plug-in parameters lose precision or come back outside their declared range.
labels.root_cause: Integer parameters were resolved through f64.

labels.symptom: Graphs cannot use custom marker designs or a reusable design list.
Exported SVG files open at about three quarters of the intended document size.
labels.root_cause: The SVG writer wrote unitless width and height, which viewers read as pixels instead of points.

labels.symptom: A host page that embeds the web app cannot open files in it or receive its saves.
On macOS the app crashes when a file open or save dialog is resized.
labels.root_cause: The blocking rfd dialog runModal ran inside winit's event handler, which triggered a re-entrancy panic that could not unwind.

labels.symptom: SVG files sized in mm, cm, in or pt open 4/3 too large.
labels.root_cause: Absolute root width/height units were converted at 96 px per inch while the document uses 1 user unit = 1 pt.

labels.symptom: Documents cannot be exported as TIFF, BMP or Targa files.
In imported PDF text with individual glyph spacing, glyphs land away from their original positions.
labels.root_cause: The importer used one tracking value for a whole line instead of per-glyph tracking.

labels.symptom: Dragging a fully selected path by one anchor moves only that anchor, and Alt-drag does not copy the path.
labels.root_cause: The press check treated a fully selected path as not having the pressed anchor selected.

labels.symptom: Align to Artboard aligns to the artboard under the selection instead of the active artboard.
labels.root_cause: object.align did not receive the active artboard index.

labels.symptom: Align run from the command palette or a shortcut reports success but moves nothing, and unknown option values are silently treated as defaults.
labels.root_cause: Command parameters with missing or unknown enum values fell back to defaults instead of returning errors.

labels.symptom: Hiding or locking objects through an automation command leaves them selected.
labels.root_cause: object.setProps did not deselect the objects it hid or locked.

labels.symptom: Align and Distribute move objects but leave their pattern tiles behind.
labels.root_cause: The align commands ignored the Transform Pattern Tiles preference.

labels.symptom: After locking or hiding all artwork above, those objects stay selected and Align still acts on them.
labels.root_cause: The commands did not deselect the objects they locked or hid.

labels.symptom: There is no Save for Web dialog for optimised GIF, JPEG and PNG output.
Saving a swatch library reports more swatches than the file actually holds.
labels.root_cause: The count included swatches that the file format leaves out.

labels.symptom: Unchecked checkboxes are invisible and checked ones show only a bare tick.
labels.root_cause: The theme gives egui's built-in checkbox no outline while inactive.

labels.symptom: A malformed width point index adds a new point instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: The index was read with as_u64() as usize, treating bad values as missing.

labels.symptom: Graph data cannot be transposed or x/y switched, and labels cannot contain line breaks.
When the font menu list is filtered or refreshed, the highlighted row jumps to a different font or leaves a stale live preview.
labels.root_cause: The font menu tracked the highlighted row by numeric index, not by font identity.

labels.symptom: Graphs cannot have drop shadows or a legend across the top.
There is no Asset Export panel and no Export Selection command.
Some EPS files open with a clipped page and missing stacked text strokes.
labels.root_cause: The layers import path used the artboard size instead of the bounding box, and pruning compared only lightness.

labels.symptom: The app inside the macOS release DMG fails codesign --verify --strict --deep with 'resource fork, Finder information, or similar detritus not allowed', so MDM checks report it damaged.
labels.root_cause: hdiutil makehybrid -hfs added com.apple.FinderInfo xattrs to every file in the DMG.

labels.symptom: In a rotated view, an artboard's name floats away from the artboard's corner.
labels.root_cause: The label was placed at the screen bounding box's corner instead of the artboard's mapped corner.

labels.symptom: The interface theme does not follow the operating system's light or dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: There was no System theme option and no tracking of the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: The keyboard shortcuts for paragraph alignment do nothing.
The Windows installer doesn't offer to create a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The MSI had no Shortcuts wizard page and no desktop shortcut component.

labels.symptom: There is no panel to view, copy or export the CSS for the selected art.
Raising Image Trace's Noise setting produces more paths instead of fewer.
labels.root_cause: A single denoise merge pass left merged specks behind as new isolated islands when their neighbour was merged away later.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Clippy fails with dead-code errors for the wasm web build.
labels.root_cause: Native-only helper functions lacked the cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32")) attribute their callers had.

labels.symptom: In the two-column toolbar, the fill/stroke and colour buttons are tiny and hard to click.
labels.root_cause: The button sizes were fixed and did not follow the toolbar's layout.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image copied from a web browser pastes its HTML markup or address as text instead of the picture.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard text next to the image that held markup was not recognised as naming the picture, so it was pasted as text.

labels.symptom: Graph column widths cannot exceed 100% and first row/column in front and filled lines options are missing.
Graph label formatting is lost when the graph is redrawn.
labels.root_cause: Graphs did not store per-label-kind character styles.

labels.symptom: Graph data can only be entered as free-form CSV text instead of in a worksheet.
Documents cannot be exported as PSD files.
Gradients with transparent stops look different on the canvas than in exports and browsers.
labels.root_cause: Canvas gradients interpolated alpha premultiplied, using the peniko default.

labels.symptom: An imported SVG object whose mask contains only hidden art shows up unmasked.
labels.root_cause: A mask with no art children was dropped on import.

labels.symptom: A placed SVG is fitted to its artwork bounds instead of its viewBox, and the crop option is ignored.
labels.root_cause: The SVG place code always used the art's bounds, whatever the crop setting was.

labels.symptom: While drawing a star, its inner-radius ratio cannot be changed with modifier keys.
PDF export silently renders raster effects at a lower resolution than requested for large objects.
labels.root_cause: A per-image pixel cap lowered effect resolution without any warning.

labels.symptom: Shapes drawn through automation with only a fill unexpectedly get a black outline.
labels.root_cause: Tool descriptions did not explain that omitted paint fields inherit the default appearance.

labels.symptom: Edit Toolbar opens a resizable popup that can fill the screen, and tools can't be dragged onto the toolbar.
labels.root_cause: All Tools was shown as a centred modal with no drag-and-drop editing.

labels.symptom: PDF export doesn't convert colours to the destination profile, embed ICC profiles, or write selectable text.
In dark themes the Selection and Direct Selection tool icons look swapped.
labels.root_cause: Both arrow icons were tinted entirely with the theme colour and had no fixed black or white fill.

labels.symptom: App icon uses animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
Shift-clicking doesn't select more than one artboard.
labels.root_cause: The artboard tool and panel only supported selecting one artboard.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed file with enormous shape coordinates crashes the app and loses unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: vello_cpu panics or tries to allocate huge amounts of memory for non-finite or enormous device-space geometry, which aborts the process.

labels.symptom: Passing an automation root flag without a value starts the control channel without file-system confinement.
labels.root_cause: Root argument parsing accepted missing, empty or repeated values and replaced the read root with None.

labels.symptom: Corners where a curve meets a line, or where two curves meet, cannot be rounded.
labels.root_cause: Live Corners only treated anchors between two straight segments as corners.

labels.symptom: File > Print has no print dialog and can't print through the system.
The Zig Zag effect dialog only has number fields and a dropdown instead of sliders and radio buttons.
labels.root_cause: The effect dialog used the generic parameter layout.

labels.symptom: The Offset Path dialog always opens on default values instead of the last ones used.
labels.root_cause: Dialog values were not stored with remembered dialog options.

labels.symptom: A marquee drawn inside a filled background also selects the background.
labels.root_cause: Hit test counted a rectangle wholly inside a filled shape as touching it.

labels.symptom: Themes can't be starred as favorites, and there's no quick menu for switching between them.
Clicking the canvas with the Rectangular Grid tool opens no options dialog.
labels.root_cause: The UI did not handle the tool's dialog request.

labels.symptom: EPS and PostScript files can't be opened, and print can't write a PostScript file.
On Linux Wayland sessions, dragging a file from the file manager onto the window does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 delivers no file drop events on native Wayland; a preference to open through XWayland was missing.

labels.symptom: A selected gradient mesh shows no lines or points with the selection tools.
labels.root_cause: The selection highlight did not draw gradient mesh lines and points.

labels.symptom: Large documents are slow to select, apply live effects or boolean path operations to, and undo history uses too much memory.
labels.root_cause: Hot spots in selection lookups, effect evaluation and per-node appearance copies kept in undo history.

labels.symptom: A blend's straight spine cannot be bent into a curve.
labels.root_cause: No command existed to reshape a blend spine segment.

labels.symptom: Alt-clicking a hidden layer's eye hides everything instead of showing only that layer.
labels.root_cause: Hide/Lock Others left the clicked layer's own state unchanged.

labels.symptom: A path with several subpaths can't be released into separate paths.
Automation preview renders only the first artboard of a multi-page document.
Integration test lacks the house-style header comment.
Each step of an automation command batch is its own undo step, flooding the history.
The roadmap overstates how close the app is to parity with the commercial original.
An automation agent can't list the files in a folder it was given and has to guess file names.
A colour picker popup can't be dragged to another place.
File › Scripts › Other Script… appears in the menu but does nothing, so JavaScript scripts can't be run.
labels.root_cause: There was no embedded scripting engine connected to the command registry.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated across repos instead of using shared actions.
Thai text falls back to an arbitrary display font instead of the system's Thai UI font.
labels.root_cause: Font fallback took the first loaded face, or the first installed file in path order, that had the glyphs, with no preference for fonts made for the script.

labels.symptom: In text editing, the arrow keys and Delete stop inside Thai clusters, accented letters or emoji, so typing or deleting there splits the character.
labels.root_cause: Caret movement stepped one code point at a time instead of one extended grapheme cluster at a time.

labels.symptom: The type parity document had two status lines after two branches were merged.
labels.root_cause: A merge conflict in the docs was resolved by keeping both lines.

labels.symptom: Thai, Lao, Khmer and Myanmar paragraphs don't wrap between words and overflow until the next space.
labels.root_cause: Line breaking only used spaces, hyphens and CJK, with no dictionary segmentation for these scripts.

labels.symptom: With Czech selected, panels, dialogs, tooltips and messages appear in English.
labels.root_cause: The Czech catalog only had menu labels.

labels.symptom: PDF/X export is refused.
The font menu's script filter has no Thai option, so Thai fonts must be found by name.
In the web build, Thai text shows as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: No Thai fallback font was bundled or fetched where no fonts are installed.

labels.symptom: A single click with the polar grid tool does not open a dialog for entering its dimensions.
Revolve effect shading shows bands on curved profiles, and the open ends can't be capped.
In text editing, Ctrl/Alt+arrow and double-click treat a whole Thai run as one word and stop at combining marks.
labels.root_cause: Word boundaries ignored dictionary segmentation for space-less scripts and did not count combining marks as word characters.

labels.symptom: Strokes can't have parallel lane lines with dots or dashes.
License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
The Print Tiling tool does nothing, and the advanced print options are missing.
On Linux hybrid-GPU laptops whose Wayland compositor runs on the discrete GPU, the window opens empty with no error.
labels.root_cause: Adapter selection preferred the GPU driving the built-in panel over the system's order, so frames were drawn on a GPU the compositor didn't show.

labels.symptom: Text can't be set to show Arabic, Hindi or Farsi digits.
The Spiral decay setting accepts values up to 150% that the drawn spiral does not reflect.
labels.root_cause: The setting range was not clamped to the 99.99% cap of the geometry generator.

labels.symptom: Thai, Arabic and Chinese text show missing glyphs in release builds because those fonts are not bundled.
labels.root_cause: Release workflows pinned an old craft-fonts commit that has only the Japanese fonts.

labels.symptom: Parts of the interface and messages stay in English when Brazilian Portuguese is selected.
labels.root_cause: The pt-BR catalog was missing many UI labels and engine messages.

labels.symptom: Imported multi-paragraph type has overlapping lines, or lines spaced too far apart, when paragraphs have space before or after.
labels.root_cause: Leading was taken from the laid-out line distance, which already included paragraph spacing, so the spacing was applied twice.

labels.symptom: An imported file reports an installed font as missing when the font's family name contains a hyphen.
labels.root_cause: The PostScript font name was split at its first hyphen before any lookup by exact PostScript name.

labels.symptom: In imported files, copies of area type and type on a path land on top of the original.
labels.root_cause: The frame was taken from the text document, which keeps the original's path, instead of each object's own /Art path.

labels.symptom: Make Compound Path leaves overlapping areas filled instead of cutting holes.
labels.root_cause: Path directions were kept as drawn under the non-zero fill rule, so overlaps with the same winding stayed filled.

labels.symptom: A test of placed-file change tracking fails at random in CI.
labels.root_cause: The test's simulated clock ran out before the background link scan finished on a busy machine.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app falls back from Direct3D 12 to OpenGL at startup because of shader compile errors.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's Auto DX12 shader compiler loaded a foreign dxcompiler.dll without dxil.dll, and the unsigned-DXIL warning was treated as a compile error.

labels.symptom: With anchor points selected, the Align buttons move the whole path instead of aligning the points.
labels.root_cause: object.align only worked on whole objects.

labels.symptom: An object moved by one of its anchors stops slightly beside another object's anchor instead of snapping onto it.
labels.root_cause: Smart Guides snapping during a move aligned only the selection's bounds, not the grabbed point.

labels.symptom: Command sweep and import fuzz tests pass even when a command panics, because the panic is turned into an ordinary error.
labels.root_cause: The engine guard converts panics into EngineError::Internal and the tests treated that like any other error.

labels.symptom: Art moved or duplicated with an artboard ignores the Transform Pattern Tiles preference.
labels.root_cause: The artboard move, duplicate and rearrange commands moved art without applying the pattern-tile transform preference.

labels.symptom: A test that compares two PDF exports fails intermittently when they are written in different seconds.
labels.root_cause: The comparison ignored CreationDate and ModDate but not the XMP dates or the file ID, which change with the write time.

labels.symptom: Clicking Align to Key Object sets no key object, so align reports that there is no key object.
labels.root_cause: The button only stored Key as the Align To choice and never ran select.key.

labels.symptom: Automation cannot read the key object, and setting it with an invalid id silently clears it.
labels.root_cause: select.key did not validate its id and inspect did not report the key.

labels.symptom: Shortcut set files (.kys) from another app cannot be imported.
Choosing Set Key Object in the command palette cancels the key object instead of setting one.
labels.root_cause: The palette labeled select.key as Set Key Object, but running it without an id cancels the key.

labels.symptom: A new compound path takes the front object's appearance, and changing the fill rule on an inner path has no visible effect.
labels.root_cause: Make Compound Path did not inherit the backmost object's fill and stroke, and the fill rule was set on the member path instead of the parent compound path.

labels.symptom: One translated word appears in several menu items that need different words in the translation.
labels.root_cause: A shared translation key cannot give different translations for different contexts.

labels.symptom: PDF export doesn't write layers or overprint.
Shape Builder returns a line's loose end as a piece that runs out and back.
labels.root_cause: The planar map merges points only within eps, but the sweep can cut a crossing at points farther apart than that.

labels.symptom: Commands that change nothing still add an undo step, clear Redo and mark the document modified.
labels.root_cause: Object and distort commands edited the document without first checking whether anything would change.

labels.symptom: On macOS the Save dialog has no file format selector, unlike on Windows.
labels.root_cause: The native macOS save panel is opened without an accessory view for choosing the format.

labels.symptom: Clicking an already selected anchor with Direct Selection does not narrow the selection to that anchor.
labels.root_cause: The release without a drag never reduced the selection to the clicked anchor.

labels.symptom: On Windows the Hand and Zoom tools show a four-headed move arrow or the default cursor instead of a hand or magnifier.
labels.root_cause: winit maps egui's Grab/Grabbing cursors to IDC_SIZEALL on Windows and has no ZoomIn/ZoomOut cursors.

labels.symptom: With Direct Selection, dragging a corner widget rounds every corner instead of only that one.
PDF export can't write page thumbnails, fast web view or PDF 1.3 files.
Roadmap and gaps docs don't yet record the large-document performance work.
The eyedropper picks up nothing when clicking an empty artboard background.
labels.root_cause: A click that hit no object ended without sampling the artboard color.

labels.symptom: When an automation request loses its reply, the edit gets applied twice.
labels.root_cause: The MCP remote backend reconnects and resends a request that failed mid-flight, even though the app may already have applied it.

labels.symptom: Colour image trace merges close dark tones and gives far fewer colours than requested.
labels.root_cause: The histogram used fixed 5-bit bins per channel, so tones less than 8 values apart always shared a bin.

labels.symptom: Exported SVGs open at 75% of their size in other programs.
labels.root_cause: Width and height were written without units, so other readers treat them as 96-dpi pixels.

labels.symptom: A CMYK colour set through automation with a component of 1 or less is stored far too dark, for example K 0.79 becomes 79%.
labels.root_cause: Each CMYK component picked its own percent or fraction scale instead of one scale for the whole colour.

labels.symptom: Agent instructions don't point to the shared test corpora.
Builds and tests are not checked on FreeBSD.
Workspace version bumped to 0.3.0 for release.
There is no FreeBSD release package to download.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no FreeBSD packaging job.

labels.symptom: FreeBSD CI tests time out or fail when they call git on the synced checkout.
labels.root_cause: The workflow had no git installed, did not mark the checkout as safe.directory, and gave the VM only 2 vCPUs.

labels.symptom: The CI clippy step fails after updating to Rust 1.99.
labels.root_cause: The new clippy lint chunks_exact_to_as_chunks flags chunks_exact calls with constant sizes.

labels.symptom: Long menus run off the bottom of the window and can't be scrolled, the Home button opens New Document, and Ctrl/Cmd+N makes a blank document without showing the dialog.
labels.root_cause: Menus had no scrolling, and an engine command claimed the New shortcut ahead of the UI command.

labels.symptom: Building with an older Rust toolchain fails with dependency errors instead of a clear minimum version message.
labels.root_cause: rust-version was declared as 1.90 while egui 0.36 needs rustc 1.95.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Japanese, and there is no vertical text.
Imported SVG non-scaling strokes come in too thick.
labels.root_cause: usvg drops vector-effect so the importer never saw it.

labels.symptom: Imported SVG text with paint-order stroke shows the stroke over the letters.
labels.root_cause: Text import never read paint-order.

labels.symptom: SVG and CSS export write semibold as bold and light or medium as regular.
labels.root_cause: font_props wrote only bold or nothing instead of numeric weights.

labels.symptom: Ctrl with numpad plus or Shift+= does not zoom in.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut parser mapped = to Key::Equals while egui reports numpad and dedicated plus as Key::Plus.

labels.symptom: Swatches, colour picker, gradients, stroke options, appearance targeting and masks are missing or incomplete.
The hint bar shows macOS key names (Option, Cmd) on Windows and Linux.
labels.root_cause: Hint text had hard-coded macOS key names instead of going through the platform shortcut formatter.

labels.symptom: Modifiers sent with automation key, click or drag commands are ignored by most of the app.
labels.root_cause: Synthetic events carried modifiers but handlers read egui's live modifier state, which never got a ModifiersChanged event.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+Shift+V does the same as plain paste instead of its own command.
labels.root_cause: egui turns every Cmd+V chord into a Paste event and the app always ran plain Paste.

labels.symptom: Rotated objects lose their angle and show an axis-aligned bounding box.
labels.root_cause: Rotation was baked into geometry with no persistent angle.

labels.symptom: Clicking with the Type tool and typing nothing leaves invisible empty text objects in the document.
labels.root_cause: Point type was created on click and never discarded when editing ended empty.

labels.symptom: Typing a math expression in a numeric field with a unit suffix like px fails, and double-click doesn't select the suffix.
labels.root_cause: Unit parser only allowed bare numbers as operands, and fields didn't select the whole text on focus.

labels.symptom: There is no way to lock width and height proportions when resizing objects via input fields.
Saving or exporting with a name typed without an extension creates a file with no extension.
labels.root_cause: Save panels kept the typed name instead of appending the chosen format's extension.

labels.symptom: Sandboxed WebAssembly plug-ins cannot be installed or run.
The docs replaced the reference app's name with neutral wording.
labels.root_cause: The brands check also scanned Markdown pages.

labels.symptom: Pressing Undo while typing or dragging also undoes the step before, and the in-progress work cannot be redone.
labels.root_cause: Undo cancelled the open interaction without recording it, then popped another history entry.

labels.symptom: The window opens larger than the screen on small displays, hiding the status bar, and does not remember its size or position.
labels.root_cause: The window size was fixed and was never checked against the monitor or saved.

labels.symptom: In short windows, the bottom of the toolbar and the panel icon strip are cut off and cannot be scrolled.
labels.root_cause: The toolbar and the dock icon column were not wrapped in a scroll area.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking a grouped toolbar tool does not show its hidden sub-tools.
labels.root_cause: Releasing the same click counted as a click outside the flyout, so it closed in the same frame.

labels.symptom: At a large UI scale, the Save Changes dialog runs off the edge of the window or its layout breaks.
labels.root_cause: The shared dialog frame's minimum and maximum widths were not capped to the window size.

labels.symptom: Renaming a layer never takes effect: Enter, Escape or clicking elsewhere leaves the name field open.
labels.root_cause: The text field called request_focus every frame, so lost_focus was never true.

labels.symptom: There are no Mirror & Cut, Line Cut or Rectangle Cut tools.
There are no live colour-adjustment effects.
There is no Vector Halftone command.
Installed fonts such as Arial are reported missing unless something earlier in the session triggered a system font scan.
labels.root_cause: The system font catalog stayed empty until a fallback or a manual action scanned the font folders.

labels.symptom: Font menus offer only a few bundled fonts instead of the installed ones.
labels.root_cause: Font lists only included the bundled fonts.

labels.symptom: Chinese, Japanese and Korean names show as empty boxes in panels and document tabs.
labels.root_cause: The UI fonts had no CJK coverage and no fallback to installed system fonts.

labels.symptom: EPS export and transparency flattening of dense artwork never finishes.
labels.root_cause: Region finding ran one full contour pass per coverage mask, so cost grew as masks times segments.

labels.symptom: A hatch bounded by a spline disappears without warning when importing an older DXF file.
labels.root_cause: The spline edge parser took the loop's source-object count as a fit-point count when the file had no fit data.

labels.symptom: Tool options reset when switching tools or relaunching.
Pressing Delete or Backspace in a point-editing tool deletes the whole artwork instead of the selected points.
labels.root_cause: The tool did not claim the key, so shortcut routing fell through to the global clear command.

labels.symptom: Piping the command-line tool's output into a program that closes early, such as head, makes it panic with a broken pipe error.
labels.root_cause: println!/print! panic when stdout is closed.
bug_markers: failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe

labels.symptom: The Define Grid dialog opens with fixed defaults and switches every grid to 2-point.
labels.root_cause: A generic form was used instead of one prefilled from the current grid.

labels.symptom: Envelope distort lacks real dialogs, Reset with Warp/Mesh and full Envelope Options.
Type inside an envelope is exported undistorted, and on the canvas the whole line is painted in the first run's colour.
labels.root_cause: Every exporter passed None as the text outliner.

labels.symptom: Puppet Warp pins can't rotate the art, several pins can't be selected at once, and Select All Pins deselects them.
Liquify tools have no options dialog, ignore pen pressure, and their Brush Affects options do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Pen pressure was hard-coded to 1.0 and the Brush Affects options were ignored.

labels.symptom: Perspective grid presets menu was a mislabelled reset to the 2-point grid, with no way to save presets.
An export test fails about one run in three because exported files carry a creation timestamp.
labels.root_cause: EPS export stamps %%CreationDate to the second, so two exports a moment apart can differ.

labels.symptom: Perspective Selection tool cannot scale, copy, move perpendicular to the plane or nudge in perspective.
The swatch, gradient and appearance panels lacked depth.
Blend Options is a generic form, and pressing OK turns a Smooth Color blend into 5 steps.
labels.root_cause: The dialog wasn't prefilled from the selected blend.

labels.symptom: A blend's spine and key objects cannot be edited directly on the canvas.
Puppet Warp pins have to be placed by hand, warps stack on each other and pins don't follow Undo.
labels.root_cause: Each warp started from the already-warped shape, and pins weren't stored in the document state that Undo restores.

labels.symptom: Perspective planes cannot be moved along their normals, with or without their objects.
Perspective grid lacks Lock Grid, Lock Station Point, Snap to Grid and Show Rulers options.
Liquify tools stop applying when the brush is held still, distort non-path objects, and long strokes are slow.
labels.root_cause: Liquify had no time-based ticking and reapplied the whole stroke on every sample.

labels.symptom: Width tool ignores compound paths and shows width points only on the first subpath.
labels.root_cause: Width tool only handled the first subpath of simple paths.

labels.symptom: Blends between objects with different strokes, gradients, groups or text interpolate poorly or lose attributes on Expand/Release.
labels.root_cause: Blend interpolation only handled basic path geometry and fills.

labels.symptom: Envelopes don't bend images, symbols or gradients, and rotated envelopes re-warp along the page axes.
labels.root_cause: Envelopes didn't store their own frame.

labels.symptom: The docs did not explain how automation should answer save-changes prompts on close or quit.
Fills and strokes could not overprint individually.
Type and symbols on a perspective grid aren't truly projected or editable.
The perspective grid widgets don't behave like the reference app.
Envelopes can't be edited on the canvas.
The interface can't be shown in languages other than English, such as Traditional Chinese.
labels.root_cause: There was no localisation framework, and Windows locale detection needs the registry because Windows sets no LANG.

labels.symptom: Typing with a Japanese input method inserts raw romaji instead of the composed text.
labels.root_cause: egui Ime events were not handled, and IMEOutput was not sent while editing text.

labels.symptom: Vertical Japanese text breaks lines in the wrong places, and Latin text comes out upside down in fonts that have vrt2.
labels.root_cause: Layout requested vrt2 glyphs and then rotated them again, and line breaking had no kinsoku rules.

labels.symptom: Fonts named by a localized or PostScript name show up as missing.
labels.root_cause: The font database indexed only the primary family name, and a race could report a loaded face as missing.

labels.symptom: The Color Guide and Edit Colors dialogs were missing or incomplete.
The CI clippy step fails on newer Rust because of byte_char_slices.
labels.root_cause: A test used [b'\n'], which the byte_char_slices lint rejects.

labels.symptom: On Windows the Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs show a blank icon, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds didn't use the Windows GUI subsystem.

labels.symptom: The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds used the console subsystem.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be switched to Czech.
Text in imported PDF documents shows in a fallback font when the font family name contains hyphens.
labels.root_cause: PostScript font names were split at the first hyphen into family and style instead of being looked up by the face's PostScript name.

labels.symptom: No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: The MCP server offers no prompts, resource templates, completions or logging.
labels.root_cause: Only tools and two fixed resources were implemented.

labels.symptom: Blend modes, non-isolated groups and layer clipping masks did not match the reference app.
The repo ships a large bundled Japanese font instead of taking Japanese fonts from the shared font set.
labels.root_cause: Japanese fonts were committed into the repo instead of being an optional craft-fonts build input.

labels.symptom: The Live Paint Bucket does not fill areas enclosed by crossing lines.
labels.root_cause: Live Paint only built faces from filled closed shapes, ignoring open paths as edges.

labels.symptom: Shift+dragging an already selected object deselects it instead of moving it with a constraint.
labels.root_cause: Shift-press on a selected object toggled selection immediately and went idle instead of deferring the toggle to release.

labels.symptom: Imported DXF Fit and Aligned text is set at its own size instead of spanning between its two points.
labels.root_cause: The DXF importer ignored the second alignment point when sizing Fit/Aligned text.

labels.symptom: Applying a Pathfinder effect from the Effect menu to several selected objects does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The live Pathfinder effect only combines group contents and loose selections were not grouped first.

labels.symptom: Font menus on macOS list hidden system families whose names start with a dot, such as .LastResort.
labels.root_cause: The font family list did not filter out macOS's hidden families whose names start with a dot.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the canvas does nothing; no context menu opens.
labels.root_cause: The canvas ignored the right mouse button.

labels.symptom: Dialogs are taller than their content and menus open much wider than their items.
labels.root_cause: The button row used a right-to-left layout that filled the remaining height, all dialogs shared one window id, and menu items forced the full popup width.

labels.symptom: A click just outside the canvas edge acts on the centre of the view.
labels.root_cause: A press inside egui's interaction radius but outside the canvas rect fell back to rect.center().

labels.symptom: The README does not list FreeBSD as a supported platform.
Wide panel flyouts spread over the panel icon column.
labels.root_cause: The flyout was pinned by its left edge, so wider content grew to the right.

labels.symptom: Small dialogs stretch across the whole window width.
labels.root_cause: The OK/Cancel row was laid out at ui.available_width().

labels.symptom: A font test fails on machines where the full Source Sans 3 family is installed.
labels.root_cause: The test assumed the bundled font was the only copy of the family.

labels.symptom: There is no way to remove an anchor point while keeping the curve's shape.
User-chosen names such as fonts, styles and workspaces are shown translated when they match a translated word.
labels.root_cause: Shared widgets passed every label through translation, including user and file names.

labels.symptom: Comments in release.yml point to docs/releasing.md, which does not exist.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow was copied from a sibling app without its releasing document.

labels.symptom: Dragging across text not being edited only places the caret instead of selecting.
labels.root_cause: Press on non-edited text did not start a selection.

labels.symptom: The README has no star history chart.
EPS files saved by the reference app fail to open.
labels.root_cause: The PostScript interpreter was missing resource categories, clipsave/cliprestore, languagelevel and shared intervals, and the TIFF preview fallback also failed.

labels.symptom: The roadmap was missing entries for recent fixes.
A text frame dragged with the Type tool lands 12 pt below the dragged rectangle.
labels.root_cause: A hardcoded +12 y offset was passed to text.create.

labels.symptom: While the automation control port is open, a web page can send commands to the app via a cross-origin POST.
labels.root_cause: The control server replied with an error to non-JSON lines but kept reading, then executed the JSON body.

labels.symptom: Groups, layers and type objects can now have their own appearance.
The command palette shows old keyboard shortcuts after they are edited.
labels.root_cause: Palette entry cache key did not include the shortcut editor generation.

labels.symptom: Most menu labels stay in English when the interface language is Japanese.
labels.root_cause: Japanese translation table covered only a few menu labels.

labels.symptom: Dragging from a ruler onto the canvas does not create a guide.
labels.root_cause: Rulers were only painted; no drag handling created guides.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking the Hand, Zoom or transform tool buttons does nothing.
labels.root_cause: open_options did not handle these tools.

labels.symptom: The status bar's artboard navigator ignores clicks, and Fit Artboard always fits the first artboard.
labels.root_cause: The button responses were dropped, and fit always used the first artboard.

labels.symptom: With the mouse, Free Transform cannot distort, apply perspective or shear.
labels.root_cause: The operation was chosen only from the modifiers held at the press, which the canvas intercepts.

labels.symptom: Swatch libraries are added: a library panel, generated libraries, and saving and loading libraries.
Exporting only the selection never reports encoder warnings about options that were not applied.
labels.root_cause: The selection export used an encode function that drops warnings.

labels.symptom: Inspecting a document reports 'None' as the fill and stroke of coloured text.
labels.root_cause: Paint was read from the type object's own appearance instead of from its characters.

labels.symptom: The docs describe inspect's paint output as an object, but it is a label string.
labels.root_cause: The documentation was inaccurate.

labels.symptom: The MCP save tool's description says it saves in the native format, but it keeps the document's own format.
labels.root_cause: The tool description was out of date.

labels.symptom: The CLI help and MCP docs leave out several formats the app can read and write.
labels.root_cause: Hand-written format lists drifted from the engine's format table.

labels.symptom: Holding Ctrl with another tool always switches to the Selection tool instead of the selection tool used last.
labels.root_cause: The temporary switch was hard-coded to the Selection tool.

labels.symptom: Type on a path in imported PDF files becomes straight lines or one object per glyph.
labels.root_cause: The importer joined glyphs into a line only while they kept the first glyph's rotation.

labels.symptom: Holding Ctrl+Space and clicking pans instead of zooming in, and Ctrl+Alt+Space does not zoom out.
labels.root_cause: Held Space always switched to pan mode before the modifiers were checked.

labels.symptom: Stroke options can now be applied to type characters, and the Stroke panel shows units and mixed values.
In vertical CJK text, upright characters overlap neighbouring tate-chu-yoko digits or drift off the column centre.
labels.root_cause: Justification gaps went inside tate-chu-yoko blocks, and upright glyphs rotated about the middle of their stretched advance.

labels.symptom: Keyboard shortcuts that combine Shift with a punctuation key never fire.
labels.root_cause: egui reports the shifted character (such as { or ?), and shortcut matching compared the chord exactly.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking text with the selection tool places no caret, so typing triggers shortcuts.
labels.root_cause: The double-click only switched to the Type tool without passing the click on to it.

labels.symptom: When a multi-artboard PDF is imported, art from one artboard appears again, offset, on the neighbouring page.
labels.root_cause: The importer kept the neighbouring artboards' art written outside each page's box.

labels.symptom: Documents with Japanese file and folder names might fail to save, open or export.
The Symbols panel does not accept drag and drop in either direction.
labels.root_cause: The panel was not a drop zone and its items sensed clicks only.

labels.symptom: Dragging the handles of an area-type frame stretches the text instead of resizing the frame.
labels.root_cause: Handle drags applied the object transform to the text, and the anchor hit test looked only at paths.

labels.symptom: Release with a version bump.
Dropping art on the Swatches or Brushes panel does nothing, and brushes can't be dragged onto paths.
labels.root_cause: The panels did not handle art drops and brushes were not drag sources.

labels.symptom: The README overview lists too many specific workflow habits.
The app crashes and loses unsaved work on bad input or unexpected errors.
labels.root_cause: unwrap/expect/panic calls in shipped code, with no panic guard.

labels.symptom: Hebrew and Arabic text is laid out left-to-right in the wrong order and is not right-aligned.
labels.root_cause: Text layout had no bidirectional algorithm or RTL shaping.

labels.symptom: Alt-clicking a layer's eye or lock toggles only that layer, not the others.
labels.root_cause: The eye and lock columns had no Alt handling.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Simplified Chinese translation, and CJK fallback fonts sit on the wrong baseline or use the wrong weight.
labels.root_cause: The zh-hans catalog and locale detection were missing, and fallback font stacks were not chosen by weight or language.

labels.symptom: Holding Space while drawing a shape keeps resizing it instead of moving it.
labels.root_cause: The shape tool ignored Mods::space during drags.

labels.symptom: Dialogs open with no field focused, so typing goes nowhere and Enter applies the default value.
labels.root_cause: The dialog and its fields never request keyboard focus when the dialog opens.

labels.symptom: Pressing Alt mid-drag with the Pen straightens the curve into the new point.
labels.root_cause: Alt set the incoming handle to the anchor instead of keeping the previous handle.

labels.symptom: Over a selected path, the Pen tool starts a new path instead of adding or deleting an anchor.
labels.root_cause: Auto Add/Delete was never implemented, and its preference was stored but never read.

labels.symptom: Holding Space while dragging out a Pen point does not move the point.
labels.root_cause: The Pen tool never read the Space modifier during a drag.

labels.symptom: Only the menus are translated into Japanese; panels, dialogs and tooltips stay in English.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese catalog only covered menu strings.

labels.symptom: Saved selections are lost on Save As, are not listed anywhere, and Edit Selection is disabled.
labels.root_cause: Saved selections were kept only in session memory, keyed by the document title.

labels.symptom: Adds freeform gradients with colour points and lines.
Rounded rectangle corners stretch into ellipses when the shape is scaled unevenly.
labels.root_cause: Uneven scale was kept in the placement matrix and applied after the corners were built.

labels.symptom: With a menu open, hovering another menu bar title doesn't switch to that menu; each title needs its own click.
labels.root_cause: egui opens menus only on click, and the menu bar lacked hover-switch logic.

labels.symptom: Only one or two weights of installed variable fonts appear in font lists.
labels.root_cause: The font database made one style per font file and ignored the variable font's fvar named instances.

labels.symptom: Automation calls that open a panel by its display name, such as 'Layers', fail; reading one object is slow on large documents.
labels.root_cause: The panel dispatcher only accepted exact lowercase ids, and reading one object serialized the whole document tree.

labels.symptom: On laptops with hybrid graphics the window flickers when the mouse moves over it.
labels.root_cause: egui-wgpu defaults to the HighPerformance power preference, so the app renders on the discrete GPU while the integrated GPU drives the display.

labels.symptom: Clicking the last anchor while drawing with the Pen adds a duplicate point and a spike.
labels.root_cause: The click appended a new anchor instead of retracting the last anchor's outgoing handle.

labels.symptom: EPS files from the reference app open only as their preview image instead of as editable vectors.
labels.root_cause: The PostScript interpreter was missing standard dictionaries and operators, and some filters were handled wrongly.

labels.symptom: Dragged bezier handles ignore Shift angle snapping and smart guides.
labels.root_cause: The raw pointer position was sent to path.setHandle with no snapping.

labels.symptom: The perspective grid cannot be hidden while a perspective tool is selected.
labels.root_cause: The grid was drawn whenever the tool was active, ignoring the visible flag.

labels.symptom: Left and Right arrow keys do nothing while dragging out a grid.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut handler passed only Up and Down arrows to a busy tool.

labels.symptom: Japanese text in imported PDFs comes in as outlines or as the wrong characters instead of editable type.
labels.root_cause: The PDF importer did not map CID fonts that have no ToUnicode map, vertical writing mode or missing fonts to live text.

labels.symptom: The font menu is a plain list of names with no samples, preview or filters.
New sublayers get duplicate or wrong default layer numbers.
labels.root_cause: Sublayer names were based on the number of objects in the document.

labels.symptom: Upright glyphs in vertical type ignore the font's vertical metrics.
labels.root_cause: Layout used a fixed one-em advance and a fixed origin instead of vmtx/VORG.

labels.symptom: Justified Japanese paragraphs have a ragged right edge.
labels.root_cause: Justification only widened word spaces, and Japanese lines have none.

labels.symptom: Clicking the double-arrow at the top of the panel dock does nothing instead of collapsing panels to icons.
labels.root_cause: The dock header painted the chevron icon but only sensed hover, not clicks.

labels.symptom: Alt-dragging an artboard moves it instead of duplicating it.
labels.root_cause: artboard.move had no copy mode.

labels.symptom: Adds Flatten Transparency, which turns transparent art into opaque art that looks the same.
Consecutive Japanese punctuation marks show a full em of space between them.
labels.root_cause: No mojikumi (Japanese punctuation spacing) support.

labels.symptom: Clicking an artboard in the panel does not make it active.
labels.root_cause: The panel kept a private selection that nothing else read.

labels.symptom: Art inside sublayers can't be properly selected or edited, and Layers panel rows for groups and objects aren't clickable.
labels.root_cause: The engine treated every child of a top-level layer as an object, so sublayers were selected instead of their art.

labels.symptom: Smart guides do not snap while resizing an object with its bounding-box handles.
labels.root_cause: Snapping was implemented only for moves.

labels.symptom: Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
Up and Down arrow keys do not change the value in panel number fields.
labels.root_cause: Number fields only parsed text on Enter or focus loss, and Response::has_focus was false in the app window.

labels.symptom: README screenshots are out of date.
Dragging a path segment with Direct Selection moves the whole path.
labels.root_cause: Any stroke hit took the select-whole-path branch.

labels.symptom: After pressing Tab, keyboard shortcuts stop working until you click the canvas or press Esc, because focus lands on a hidden field.
labels.root_cause: egui's focus navigation consumed the Tab shortcut and moved keyboard focus onto a field.

labels.symptom: Japanese text set next to Latin letters or digits gets no quarter-em space between them.
labels.root_cause: Text layout did not apply the JLREQ mojikumi spacing between Japanese and Latin characters.

labels.symptom: Vertical Type is not in the Type tool's flyout, and pressing and holding the button without moving does not open the flyout.
labels.root_cause: The flyout's hold timer did not schedule a repaint, so a 350 ms press that did not move never opened the flyout.

labels.symptom: In the browser, a file dropped on one document ends up in a different document if another document became active while the file was still loading.
labels.root_cause: The pending async web drop stored only the drop point and not the target document, so it was placed into whichever document was active when the read finished.

labels.symptom: Artboards do not snap to guides, the grid or other artboards when moved or resized.
Alt-dragging with the Rotate, Reflect, Scale or Shear tool opens the dialog instead of transforming a copy.
labels.root_cause: The tool opened its dialog on the button press when Alt was held and dropped the drag.

labels.symptom: On macOS, opening files from Finder or the Dock fails with an error saying the app cannot open them.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30's app delegate lacks application:openURLs: and the Info.plist did not declare document types.

labels.symptom: On Windows 7 the app fails at startup with GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime missing from kernel32.dll.
labels.root_cause: The default Rust Windows target and wgpu/AccessKit/file-dialog dependencies need APIs newer than Windows 7.

labels.symptom: Graphic Styles panel gains views, merging, reordering and drag and drop, and pattern editing gains Tile Edge Color and Show Swatch Bounds.
A font menu preview could stay active after the menu closed, so a canvas drag ran inside the preview and was then rolled back.
labels.root_cause: The font preview was not ended on Escape, on a click outside the menu, or when the menu was no longer drawn.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Brazilian Portuguese translation.
Leading can't be measured top-to-top from the em box, as Japanese layout expects.
Pressing Enter with a transform or selection tool active doesn't open the tool's dialog.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut handler applied a tool's UI requests only when the key was claimed, so the dialog request for Enter was dropped.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Spanish.
Characters of different sizes on one line can only be aligned on the baseline.
Double-clicking a drawing tool does not open its options.
labels.root_cause: No Tool Options dialog existed for these tools.

labels.symptom: Opening a PDF-compatible .ai file adds an extra layer holding a page-sized white rectangle.
labels.root_cause: The importer kept the reference app's page fill painted before the layers as art.

labels.symptom: CMYK images in an imported PDF are written back as RGB on PDF export without a warning.
labels.root_cause: PDF import decoded CMYK images to RGB and the model had no CMYK image storage.

labels.symptom: Exporting a document that uses a missing font silently writes the text in the fallback font without any warning.
labels.root_cause: Export paths did not report missing-font substitution; only file open did.

labels.symptom: Some font pickers lack previews, favourites and filters.
Another browser tab deletes a paused background tab's recovery copies, mistaking it for a crash.
labels.root_cause: Recovery areas were judged abandoned only from a stale heartbeat, and timers stop in paused tabs.

labels.symptom: Imported PDF or .ai files split stroked objects in two and lose hidden and nested layers.
labels.root_cause: The importer only merged identical paths and ignored view state and layer nesting.

labels.symptom: Shape Builder does not cut shapes with open paths or lines.
labels.root_cause: Open paths were not treated as cutting edges.

labels.symptom: In the browser, the canvas freezes or goes blank after the graphics device or context is lost.
labels.root_cause: Nothing handled a lost WebGPU device or WebGL context, so graphics were never recreated.

labels.symptom: Single corners of a rectangle cannot be rounded on their own.
Reading a large group over MCP returns a huge reply.
After a failed batch command, highlighted layer rows stay selected, so replaying the journal gives a different document.
labels.root_cause: The interaction undo did not save or restore the highlighted layer rows when a batch failed.

labels.symptom: Text imported from SVG shows the wrong font size when it is under a transform or viewBox scale.
labels.root_cause: The importer kept the scale in the transform instead of folding it into the font size.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Cmd+A in a focused text field selects all objects instead of the field's text.
labels.root_cause: The native macOS menu bar takes Select All, Cut, Copy and Paste before the focused text field sees them.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, the native title bar is stacked above the app's own top bar.
labels.root_cause: The window used OS decorations off macOS, so two bars were shown.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland, pasting an image finds nothing on the clipboard.
labels.root_cause: arboard was built without wayland-data-control, so it read the XWayland clipboard instead.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
Latin letters next to Hangul jamo get an unwanted Japanese–Latin quarter-em space.
labels.root_cause: Hangul Compatibility Jamo and half-width Hangul were classed as Japanese letters.

labels.symptom: Preferences for selection, the mouse wheel, tool tips and the grid are saved but have no effect.
labels.root_cause: Stored preference values were never read by the tools.

labels.symptom: Guides dragged out of the rulers cannot be selected, moved or deleted afterwards.
labels.root_cause: No tool hit-tested ruler guides, so a click on a guide went to the art under it.

labels.symptom: Inspecting a large document through automation dumps the whole tree.
labels.root_cause: inspect_document serialized the full tree, and there was no find command.

labels.symptom: An opening bracket at the start of a wrapped Japanese line keeps extra space before it, and upright vertical glyphs shift across the column.
labels.root_cause: Mojikumi didn't trim line-start brackets, and the vertical glyph offset moved the rotation pivot instead of the glyph.

labels.symptom: The Fill/Stroke chips have no popovers, panel shortcuts are missing and the Eyedropper has no options.
Changing some Preferences options for snapping, handles and type has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preferences were stored but nothing read them.

labels.symptom: Imported SVG layers with a clip path become clip groups inside Layer 1 instead of layers.
labels.root_cause: Top-level clipped groups were not treated as layers.

labels.symptom: Art on large imported PDF pages shows up on a visible layer even though its layer was hidden.
labels.root_cause: The layer scan stopped at a low operator limit, and art whose layer was unknown fell back to the visible page layer.

labels.symptom: The stroke weight dropdown shows awkward converted values in mm, cm or in.
labels.root_cause: One point-based preset list was converted into each unit.

labels.symptom: Anchors dragged with Direct Selection don't snap to points or smart guides.
labels.root_cause: The drag sent the raw pointer delta and skipped snapping.

labels.symptom: Converting the document colour mode to CMYK turns RGB greys into four-colour greys with no option to put them on black only.
labels.root_cause: The conversion always sent greys through the CMYK profile, and pattern tiles were not converted.
