labels.symptom: The Layers panel has no target circles and Expand Appearance is incomplete.
Opening a dropdown inside a popup closes the popup, so its controls cannot be used.
labels.root_cause: egui keeps only one open popup in memory, so a nested popup replaces its parent.

labels.symptom: Modal dialogs can't be moved by dragging their heading, and some choice fields aren't shown as dropdowns.
labels.root_cause: Each dialog built its own fixed modal frame with no drag handling.

labels.symptom: Numeric fields can't be adjusted by dragging their label left or right.
labels.root_cause: Field labels had no drag-to-scrub behaviour.

labels.symptom: Dropping a dragged row on the trash button does nothing.
labels.root_cause: egui's DragAndDrop take discards a payload of a different type, so a first check for another payload type consumed the drag.

labels.symptom: A tool group's flyout opens unreliably, only on right-click release or after a long press on the corner triangle.
labels.root_cause: Flyout press handling opened on release and sent corner presses through the long-press path.

labels.symptom: Tool flyouts can be torn off into floating toolbars.
Type on a path cannot be moved or flipped with the mouse, and its options dialog sends the text back to the start of the path.
labels.root_cause: There were no path-type brackets, and applying the options reset the start position.

labels.symptom: Shape Builder erase mode cannot delete edges, does not show what will be removed, and does not react to Alt until the mouse moves.
labels.root_cause: Shape builder only handled regions and the canvas did not re-hover the tool on modifier changes.

labels.symptom: Error and status-bar messages show in English when the interface is set to Spanish.
labels.root_cause: The message templates had no Spanish catalog entries, and the web build wasn't connected to i18n.

labels.symptom: Some installed fonts, and fonts installed while the app is open, are missing from the font menus.
labels.root_cause: The font scan read only the standard font folders, once at startup, and skipped registry, XDG and Flatpak host font locations.

labels.symptom: Rounded corners on non-square rectangles come out elliptical or uneven.
labels.root_cause: An uneven scale left in the transform was not folded into the shape's size and radii.

labels.symptom: Tints of global and spot colours aren't supported, and gradient stops lose their link to swatches.
Over the canvas the tool cursor lags behind the real mouse pointer.
labels.root_cause: The system cursor was hidden and the tool cursor was painted into frames that were shown late, and the surface queued two frames.

labels.symptom: Artboards cannot be copied and pasted together with their art.
Smart Guides display preferences are stored but have no effect.
labels.root_cause: Nothing read the preferences.

labels.symptom: Guides dragged out of the rulers do not snap to art, and guides cannot belong to one artboard.
The toolbar's single/double column toggle does nothing on most screens.
labels.root_cause: The toolbar was forced into two columns whenever the window was shorter than one column, ignoring the user flag.

labels.symptom: Font size and leading fields have no dropdown of preset values.
There is no Flatten Transparency dialog, preset manager or preview panel.
Pasting a screenshot or copied image from the system clipboard does nothing, or loses transparency.
labels.root_cause: Paste was enabled only for text on macOS, arboard reads only TIFF, Windows read CF_BITMAP which drops alpha, and the web build handled only SVG text.

labels.symptom: There are no install instructions for Gentoo users.
A Japanese comma or full stop at the end of a line could not hang outside the text frame.
The README no longer documents installing from the Gentoo overlay.
The desktop app writes no log anywhere, so users launching from a menu or Dock have nothing to attach to bug reports.
labels.root_cause: The desktop binary never installs a logger, so log records and panic reports are thrown away.

labels.symptom: The Properties panel lacks proper Fill/Stroke widgets and Illustrator panel shortcut keys are missing.
Text cannot be switched between point type and area type from the canvas.
There are no saved width profiles, few arrowheads, and bounds and clicks ignore the full painted stroke.
Opening legacy .ai files loses group structure, and deeply nested clips crash import.
labels.root_cause: The EPS interpreter ignored Illustrator u/U group operators, and clip nesting was unbounded, which overflowed the stack.

labels.symptom: Image Trace and other image options are hidden when an image is selected.
Holding Alt with the Pen tool does not edit a single Bézier handle, and a path cannot be cut at selected anchors.
The Type Object Selection by Path Only preference had no effect on selecting text.
labels.root_cause: The preference was stored but hit-testing never used it.

labels.symptom: Files dragged onto the window are placed into the current document instead of opening as tabs, and Presentation Mode can't be left.
labels.root_cause: winit desktop drag-and-drop gives no pointer position, so a stale position was used; the screen mode was also saved in preferences.

labels.symptom: Turning off the Anti-aliased Artwork preference did not change how the canvas was drawn.
labels.root_cause: The preference was stored but the canvas render options ignored it.

labels.symptom: The Show Pixel Grid preference had no effect at high zoom in Pixel Preview.
labels.root_cause: The preference was stored but never used by the canvas.

labels.symptom: Graphic style libraries can't be browsed, saved or loaded.
The Add and Delete Anchor Point tool icons look distorted next to the Pen tool icon.
labels.root_cause: The icons were hand-drawn instead of being based on the Pen tool's icon.

labels.symptom: EPS files from other apps open as bitmaps or fail with a PostScript typecheck error.
labels.root_cause: The PostScript interpreter lacked operators and constructs that other generators use, and fell back to the preview without saying why.

labels.symptom: Turning off the Show Home Screen preference still shows the Home screen when no document is open.
labels.root_cause: Preference was stored but never read.

labels.symptom: The Numbers Without Units Are Points preference has no effect on length fields.
labels.root_cause: Preference was stored but never read.

labels.symptom: The Auto-Collapse Iconic Panels preference has no effect; flyout panels stay open after clicking elsewhere.
labels.root_cause: Preference was stored but never read by the dock.

labels.symptom: Recording a keyboard shortcut that starts with Shift or Ctrl saves the modifier key itself, so the shortcut never works.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut recorder accepted modifier key presses as the chord's main key.

labels.symptom: You can't view only the opacity mask, SVG export loses the mask's Clip and Invert options, and the transparency grid isn't saved per document.
Smart Guides do not snap resize handles or transform tool drags onto other objects' anchors.
labels.root_cause: Scale snapping only aligned edges and transform tools did not snap the pointer.

labels.symptom: Shift-drag marquee only adds to the selection instead of toggling, and Alt-lasso drops non-path objects.
labels.root_cause: Marquee used add-only selection mode; lasso subtract replaced selection.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window with no branded background or install layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG was built without a background image or Finder view settings.

labels.symptom: Tablet pens on KDE Plasma Wayland don't reach the window, and quick pen or touch taps don't register as clicks.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 lacks Wayland tablet protocol support, and a tap pressed and released in one frame had no hover position.

labels.symptom: Turning the mouse wheel over a focused numeric field does not change its value.
labels.root_cause: Numeric field widgets handled only arrow-key stepping, not scroll wheel input.

labels.symptom: The contextual task bar cannot be dragged, pinned or reset to its default position.
Headless automation refuses to open PDF files that the desktop app opens.
labels.root_cause: The headless loader had its own file-type list that left out the PDF importer.
bug_markers: headless mode can open .vectorcraft and .svg files

labels.symptom: Object Expand gets a dialog, and gradient fills can be expanded into solid objects or a gradient mesh.
There are no Flatpak builds and AppImages don't auto-update.
On macOS the menus appear inside the window instead of in the system menu bar.
labels.root_cause: The app drew only an in-window egui menu bar.

labels.symptom: Boolean shape operations drop a corner on almost-horizontal edges, so the resulting shape comes out wrong.
labels.root_cause: linesweeper compares curves using bounding boxes only over very small y-spans, which puts edges in the wrong order.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app and lists macOS before Windows.
Panels cannot be undocked into floating panels.
There is no Italian interface; Italian locales fall back to English.
labels.root_cause: There was no Italian catalog.

labels.symptom: While drawing with the pen, holding a modifier key does not let you edit curves in place.
On Linux dual-GPU desktops under Wayland, the app crashes at startup because it picks the integrated GPU.
labels.root_cause: Forcing power_preference LowPower on every platform picked the integrated GPU, whose buffers the compositor on the other GPU could not import, which made egui-wgpu panic.
bug_markers: The surface isn't supported by this adapter

labels.symptom: An Attributes panel, a Registration colour and live trim and crop marks are added.
Agent rules allowed black-box observation of the commercial app being copied.
bug_markers: black-box observation of the running app

labels.symptom: Closing a pen path by dragging from the first anchor flickers and sometimes leaves the shape open.
labels.root_cause: Each drag move re-evaluated which path was being drawn instead of keeping the decision made on press.

labels.symptom: On macOS 27, web URLs handed to the app are queued as local files to open.
labels.root_cause: NSURL to_file_path returns a path for https URLs on macOS 27, and URLs were not filtered by isFileURL.

labels.symptom: Corner/smooth Convert buttons are missing when a whole path is selected with the anchor tools.
New type in a Japanese interface starts with Roman baseline leading instead of em box defaults.
Right-clicking a ruler does not offer a menu to change units.
Drawing tools do not snap to Smart Guides the way the Selection tool does.
labels.root_cause: Only the Selection tool used the smart-guide snapper; shape drags gathered targets from the preview.

labels.symptom: Spot colours can be defined in Lab, with options to display and separate them from Lab or CMYK values.
Imported PDF/AI files come in with the wrong layer order, an extra page layer, and type strokes split from their text.
labels.root_cause: The importer stacked layers by first painted art and left pending text and clips outside their marked-content layers.

labels.symptom: The Control bar's Transform link does not open the Transform panel.
On Linux the window freezes for several seconds when the clipboard owner doesn't respond.
labels.root_cause: The system clipboard was checked for Paste on the UI thread, and arboard's X11 read can block for up to 4 seconds.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change; EPS interpreter tests are rewritten from the PostScript reference.
Live Corner widgets appear only on rectangles, not on stars, polygons or pen paths.
labels.root_cause: Corner widgets and setLiveShape only handled live rectangles.

labels.symptom: Scale Strokes & Effects, Scale Corners and Use Preview Bounds now behave correctly during transforms.
Some imported EPS files show sheared horizontal banding across the artwork.
labels.root_cause: When an image had several data sources, the EPS importer read each source to the end on its own instead of reading them in turn.

labels.symptom: CI fails at clippy on Rust 1.98 because of constant-size chunks_exact calls.
labels.root_cause: New clippy lint chunks_exact_to_as_chunks fails under -D warnings.

labels.symptom: On macOS 27, opening a web link through the app is treated as opening a local file path.
labels.root_cause: application:openURLs: converted every NSURL to a file path without checking isFileURL, and macOS 27 returns a path for https URLs.

labels.symptom: Choosing Select All, Cut, Copy or Paste from the in-window menus acts on the document instead of the focused text field.
labels.root_cause: Opening a menu took keyboard focus from the text field, so clipboard commands were routed to the document.

labels.symptom: On Windows with Intel graphics the whole window flickers black when the mouse moves.
labels.root_cause: Vulkan adapters were preferred over DX12, and Intel's Vulkan driver flickers.

labels.symptom: Dialogs stretch to fill the screen height instead of fitting their content.
labels.root_cause: Content inside a dialog filled the available height.

labels.symptom: Image Trace menu items show a text box instead of a preset list, so presets seem missing.
labels.root_cause: Menu items opened the generic parameter form with the preset as a text field.

labels.symptom: On Windows with Intel graphics the window flickers black; Image Trace presets are not selectable.
labels.root_cause: Vulkan was preferred over DX12 on Windows; Image Trace menu used a generic form.

labels.symptom: Version bump release.
Tracing a large photo makes the app use gigabytes of memory and quit while drawing the selection.
labels.root_cause: Drawing every outline and anchor of a huge selection built an egui mesh larger than wgpu's largest buffer.

labels.symptom: Exporting a chosen artboard range to SVG writes every artboard's art.
labels.root_cause: The SVG encoder wrote the whole document regardless of the named artboards.

labels.symptom: Image Trace on a large photo crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Tracing had no budget on anchor count, so huge outputs exhausted resources.

labels.symptom: Placing a document copies its art instead of linking it, so the copy doesn't update when the file changes.
Clicking an object in a multi-selection does not make it the key object for alignment.
labels.root_cause: The selection tool had no way to set a key object by clicking.

labels.symptom: Hovering a font in the font menu makes the selected text flicker between two fonts.
labels.root_cause: The menu compared the hover against the current font read from text the preview had just changed, so it toggled preview on and off every frame.

labels.symptom: In CMYK documents, blend modes and opacity now mix inks on screen, in PDF and when flattening.
There is no way to add or delete artboards while editing artboards in the Properties panel.
labels.root_cause: The Properties panel had no artboard section for the Artboard tool.

labels.symptom: On macOS, native menus stay open after picking an item or clicking back into the window.
labels.root_cause: AppKit menu tracking was not ended on selection or outside clicks, and menus were updated while tracking was still active.

labels.symptom: Merging shapes with Shape Builder leaves stray edges and slivers inside stroked outlines.
labels.root_cause: Faces were refit separately and then joined with a boolean union, so their shared edges did not line up exactly.

labels.symptom: Export and the command line cannot write .ai files, even though Save As can.

Saving an SVG drops hidden objects and their data-* attributes.

labels.symptom: Duplicate Artboard leaves out artwork that touches the artboard's right or bottom edge.
labels.root_cause: kurbo::Rect::contains is half-open, so objects flush with the right or bottom edge counted as outside.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app crashes after resizing an Open or Save dialog and releasing the mouse.
labels.root_cause: The modal file dialog ran synchronously inside the window's event handler and re-entered it.

labels.symptom: With zoom-with-mouse-wheel turned on, each wheel notch jumps the zoom instead of gliding smoothly.
labels.root_cause: Each notch's zoom was applied on the frame it arrived instead of being spread over a few frames.

labels.symptom: Smart guides stop snapping when Shift constrains an anchor drag.
labels.root_cause: The constrained drag skipped snapping entirely.

labels.symptom: A contributor is missing from the About window credits.
Exporting or screenshotting at a very large size crashes the app and loses unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: Raster export did not check the output size against the rasteriser's 65535 px per-side limit before rendering.

labels.symptom: There are no JPEG CMYK/ICC, PNG-8, GIF or WebP export options and no text export.
Calligraphic and bristle brushes have no options dialog and ignore pen pressure.
Tests fail at random in CI because of clock-dependent dates and a race over a network port.
labels.root_cause: Journal replays read the current clock instead of recorded dates, and the connect test did not hold its own port.

labels.symptom: Font menus always showed English family names, even when the font had a native-language name.
Reselect fails with 'nothing selected' after Deselect following a Select Same command.
labels.root_cause: Select Same needs a selected reference object, which no longer exists after Deselect.

labels.symptom: Shift-clicking a target circle in the Layers panel does not add to the selection.
labels.root_cause: Clicking a target circle always replaced the selection.

labels.symptom: Polygon properties, Flare Tool Options and tool double-click options are missing.
The Display Print Size at 100% Zoom preference had no effect on Actual Size.
Number fields with a spinner and preset dropdown look like three separate boxes with mismatched heights and double borders.
labels.root_cause: The text field frame was sized by its text and came out taller than the row, and the parts did not overlap to share borders.

labels.symptom: Variable-width stroke profile previews spill out of the Profile menu over the Stroke panel.
labels.root_cause: The preview assumed widths stay within the stroke weight and wasn't clipped.

labels.symptom: The automation/MCP server can read and write files anywhere the user can, with no way to confine it to a folder.
labels.root_cause: No read/write root checks on file paths used by automation commands.

labels.symptom: PDF export loses raster effects, pattern strokes and freeform gradients, and ignores the compression settings.
The Transform effect dialog was a plain list of fields without sliders, dial or reference point.
Editing artboard X/Y coordinates with Move Artwork enabled leaves the artwork behind.
labels.root_cause: artboard.setProps had no translation path for contained artwork.

labels.symptom: No way to follow the system light/dark appearance or pick separate light and dark themes.
Opening a crafted EPS/PS/AI file freezes or crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Stitched gradient function builder had no stop cap, recursion limit or shared-child guard.

labels.symptom: Drawings can't be exported to DXF.
Pixelate effects (Color Halftone, Crystallize, Mezzotint, Pointillize) are not available.
Linked files edited in another app do not update even when automatic link updating is enabled.
labels.root_cause: Link update checks ran only when a document opened, not when the window regained focus.

labels.symptom: A text field clears itself while typing because each keystroke is lost before it is committed.
labels.root_cause: The field re-read its text from the model on every frame instead of keeping an edit buffer.

labels.symptom: Gradient type and draw-mode options are missing from the panel.
The interface can be shown in German.
PSD and PSB files cannot be placed or opened.
labels.root_cause: No PSD reader existed for the merged image.

labels.symptom: A Direct Selection marquee doesn't select type, images or other objects that have no anchors.
labels.root_cause: The marquee gathered only path anchors.

labels.symptom: Importing a PDF or AI file splits one text object into editable type plus outlined glyphs.
labels.root_cause: Subset font glyphs with no Unicode mapping fell back to outlines instead of being matched against the installed font.

labels.symptom: SVG import flattens symbols, patterns and filters and misses linked images.
A graph's value axis with a manual minimum and maximum is drawn with a rounded range, so bars come out the wrong height.
labels.root_cause: The override range went through the same rounding as the calculated axis, and tick loops added up the step instead of counting ticks.

labels.symptom: Line graphs have no Edge-to-Edge Lines option, and radar graphs ignore the Mark and Connect Data Points options.
The De-Interlace and NTSC Colors video effects are missing.
The Libraries panel has no search, no grouping and no export or import of libraries.
Live Corner widgets don't appear when more than one object or vertex is selected.
labels.root_cause: Widgets were shown only when the selection was exactly one path.

labels.symptom: README status section updated.
Imported .ai files open without the graphics that came from placed PDFs.
labels.root_cause: ForeignObject entries in the editing data were skipped.

labels.symptom: Blank cells in chart data are drawn as zero, and quoted numbers are treated as values.
labels.root_cause: Blank cells were stored and drawn as 0.

labels.symptom: Scatter, art and pattern brushes have no options dialog.
A failed save can leave a half-written file, and saving blocks the UI.
labels.root_cause: Saves wrote the target file directly on the UI thread instead of writing a temp file and renaming it.

labels.symptom: Some UI labels and buttons stay in English when the interface language is Chinese.
labels.root_cause: Some UI strings were hardcoded and not wrapped in translation calls.

labels.symptom: When zoomed out, artboard names overflow their artboards and overlap.
labels.root_cause: Names were drawn at a fixed screen size and not limited to the artboard's on-screen width.

labels.symptom: Contributor links in the About and credits dialog do not work.
labels.root_cause: The credits UI needed the app state passed down the call chain to open the links.

labels.symptom: Graphs can combine different chart types per series.
There is no Links panel, Placement Options or Package command for managing placed images.
There are no Texture raster effects (Craquelure, Grain, Mosaic Tiles, Patchwork, Stained Glass, Texturizer).
On NixOS the window never opens and file dialogs fail because Wayland, EGL and D-Bus libraries cannot be loaded.
labels.root_cause: The app loads Wayland, EGL and D-Bus libraries at run time, and NixOS has no /usr/lib and puts nothing on LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
bug_markers: The wayland library could not be loaded

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files onto the window shows a 'no' cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland.

labels.symptom: Linked files changed by another app aren't updated while the document is open.
The app bar is too tall with a wide search field and its own app menu, so content overflows on narrow windows.
labels.root_cause: App bar dimensions and layout diverged from the shared family design.

labels.symptom: Adds slices and the Slice and Slice Selection tools.
Inner Glow's Source option is a free text field instead of a Center/Edge dropdown.
labels.root_cause: The effect dialog had no enumerated choices for the source parameter.

labels.symptom: Graphs can show the value axis on the left, right or both sides, with separate scales.
On macOS the close, minimize and zoom buttons sit too high instead of centred on the app bar.
labels.root_cause: AppKit places traffic-light buttons for a standard title bar shorter than the custom app bar.

labels.symptom: Graph axes have no options for tick mark length and count, category tick marks, or a prefix and suffix on axis labels.
Imported PDFs keep masks, patterns, editable text, meshes and layers instead of being flattened.
Adds the Diffuse Glow, Glass and Ocean Ripple distort effects.
On hybrid-GPU laptops with the high-performance GPU chosen, the window never appears and the app stays running in the background.
labels.root_cause: The first frame was never presented, and start-up recovery only reacted to errors or panics, not to a stall.

labels.symptom: A rejected fill or stroke edit still changes the default colors used for new artwork.
labels.root_cause: Paint defaults were updated before the targets and parameters had been validated.

labels.symptom: Placing artwork with malformed rectangle or position parameters puts it in the wrong place instead of reporting an error.
labels.root_cause: The rectangle parser used filter_map(Value::as_f64), which silently dropped invalid values before validation.

labels.symptom: Rectangle Cut with malformed coordinates cuts an unintended region instead of being rejected.
labels.root_cause: The rectangle parser dropped invalid values before checking that there were exactly four coordinates.

labels.symptom: Invalid dash values are silently dropped, and failed stroke edits still change the stroke defaults for new art.
labels.root_cause: Dash parsing filtered out invalid values, and defaults were updated before the fallible steps finished.

labels.symptom: A malformed crop rectangle produces an unintended crop region.
labels.root_cause: The crop-box parser dropped invalid elements before checking the rectangle's structure.

labels.symptom: SVG export drops data attributes and accepts invalid artboard ranges.
labels.root_cause: SVG exporter did not preserve or escape data attributes, and the options dialog did not validate artboard ranges.

labels.symptom: PDF export writes bleed and trim boxes, leaves out non-printing layers and draws printer's marks.
Characters stay missing after new fonts are installed, and text rendering reads fonts more than it needs to.
labels.root_cause: Cached font fallback misses were never retried after a font rescan.

labels.symptom: Arabic shaping tests make wrong assertions, and embedded PDF fonts have no test coverage.
The progress and parity docs are out of date.
Asset export accepts invalid object IDs instead of rejecting them.
labels.root_cause: Object IDs were not validated before export assets were collected.

labels.symptom: Anchor selection commands with malformed entries apply a partial selection instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: Anchor references were parsed with filter_map, which dropped invalid entries.

labels.symptom: Path commands silently drop malformed anchors and accept the remaining geometry.
labels.root_cause: Anchors were parsed with filter_map, which dropped invalid entries.

labels.symptom: A distort command with malformed geometry or IDs silently applies a different transform.
labels.root_cause: Malformed coordinates and IDs were filtered out instead of rejected.
